relations.quote: If we are unable to obtain 300mm SOI wafers from Soitec S.A. (“Soitec”), our primary supplier, for any reason, we expect that it would take us an extended period to find a replacement supplier on commercially acceptable terms. In 2025, Soitec accounted for approximately 71% of our SOI wafer spend.
